cpu_30s.query: sum by (service, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!="",cpu="total"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!=""} > time() - 15))

cpu_recent.query: sum by (service, name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!="",cpu="total"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!=""} > time() - 15))

memory_mib.query: max by (service, name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!=""} and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!=""} > time() - 15)) / 1024 / 1024

receive_30s.query: sum by (service, name) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!="",interface="eth0"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!=""} > time() - 15))

transmit_30s.query: sum by (service, name) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!="",interface="eth0"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"compute|data|mongodb|controller",name!=""} > time() - 15))
